description: Check a social media creator's audience for authenticity signals before working with them: follower quality, engagement patterns, comment authenticity, growth and posting cadence. Returns an authenticity score (0-100) with the signals behind it and a link to the full public report. Works for Instagram best; YouTube, TikTok and X are read from public data where available. Accounts too small to judge get no score, by design. This is a signal check, not a ruling: "Flagged for review" means look closer, and it is not grounds to call a creator fake. Checks are limited per day; a recent check of the same account is reused for free.

handle.description: The creator's handle, with or without @, or a link to their profile.

platform.description: Where the account is. Ignored when a profile link is given: the platform is read off the link.

name: check_creator
title: Check a creator's audience
